bad_guidance.why: Keypad/text-entry guidance (key sizes, masking, scanner wedge, format hints) for a screen with no input at all; selected after 'confirmation screen' was classified screen=form. Also the longest record in the bundle.
Selected for 'confirmation of destructive or high-risk actions' on the word 'confirmation'; there is no dialog and nothing destructive on the done screen. Delivers a pre-registered forbidden concept.
Every clause (>=60px targets, >=20px body, idle timeout with countdown, cancel at every step) is already implemented in this codebase; useful only as a preservation reminder.

Two of three pre-registered critical concepts absent: layout.focal_hierarchy and a11y.color_not_only. The only completion cue on the screen was a green tick, and no record in the bundle says colour must not carry meaning alone.

guidance_ignored.why: The done screen has no input; nothing in the record applies.
No dialog and no destructive action on this screen; following it would have added a modal the task did not ask for.

misses.what: 'confirmation screen' classified as screen=form, which pulled comp-kiosk-keypad and comp-dialog into the bundle
intent.problem_domain empty for an explicit content/status defect ('never says the pick-up is complete')
layout.focal_hierarchy never demanded although layout-hierarchy-one-thing (platform any) carries it
a11y.color_not_only never demanded although a11y-color-not-only carries it and ranks 3rd in search on this exact sentence
env.glanceable_status demanded but its candidate data-exceptions-first lost on utility/cap
theme UNKNOWN, spacing 'irregular', surfaces 'elevated' although tokens.css declares a light+high-contrast palette, an 8px space scale and border-first surfaces
cta slot marked 'new' (cta-single-primary) on an untouched slot at moderate budget on an existing UI

regressions.query: The confirmation screen prints the receipt but never says the pick-up is complete.
regressions.expect: a11y.color_not_only is demanded as critical and a never-colour-alone record is in the bundle whenever a sentence says a screen fails to say/state/tell something

regressions.query: any 'the screen never says / does not tell the user X' sentence
regressions.expect: intent.problem_domain names a content/status-legibility domain and layout.focal_hierarchy is demanded

regressions.query: 'confirmation screen' on an existing kiosk or web flow
regressions.expect: screen resolves to a confirmation/success screen, not form; comp-dialog is not selected on feedback.confirmation_destructive unless the sentence names a destructive action

regressions.query: inspect a project whose tokens.css defines --space-1..7 on an 8px scale and an explicit light palette plus a high-contrast variant
regressions.expect: spacing KNOWN (8pt scale) and theme KNOWN (light, with high-contrast variant), not UNKNOWN
